_extraction_flags.notes: Excellent O-ISAC paper! MAP-aided IVLCS with joint comm+sensing optimization. IEEE Wireless Communications Letters 2025.

reasoning_trace.step_0_visual_inspection: Fig.1: MAP-aided IVLCS system model with comm/sensing users and blockers. Fig.2: Sum rate+MI vs users. Fig.3: Robustness against blockers. Fig.4: Mobility support. Fig.5: Trade-off between MI and sum rate.
reasoning_trace.step_1_concept_analysis: System: Movable Access Point (MAP) aided IVLCS. Uses motorized track lighting for AP positioning. Joint optimization of MAP position and user association to maximize aggregate sum rate + sensing MI. Active sensing: LED emits, PD receives echo. Addresses LOS blockage, FOV limits, and mobility.
reasoning_trace.step_2_benchmark_verification: Comm: Up to ~480 Gbps aggregate sum rate (20 APs). Sensing: MI as metric, up to ~230 Gbps equivalent. Bandwidth 5 GHz. Room 10x10x3m. 353.69% gain over fixed AP benchmark. Near-optimal (within 1% of global optimum).
reasoning_trace.step_3_strategic_critique: Contribution: First application of movable antenna (MA) concept to IVLCS. Novel optimization framework using DC programming + MM technique. Extensive trade-off analysis (Fig.5). Gap: Simulation only, no experimental validation. Complexity analysis provided.

bibliographic.title: Movable Access Point-Aided Integrated Visible Light Communication and Sensing Networks

application.scenario_description: Indoor IVLCS with movable APs (MAPs) serving mobile communication and sensing users in the presence of LOS blockers.

key_contribution.key_contribution: First application of movable antenna technology to IVLCS. Joint MAP position and user association optimization for maximizing aggregate sum rate + sensing MI.
key_contribution.gap_addressed: LOS blockage, limited FOV, random device orientation, and user mobility issues in conventional fixed AP IVLCS systems.

transmitter.notes: LED on motorized track. Half-intensity angle 60°. Responsivity 0.53 A/W. Up to 20 MAPs.

receiver.notes: PD with 1 cm² area. FOV 70°. Random device orientation modeled (Laplace distribution for polar angle).

integration.notes: Each MAP has LED (TX) + PD (RX). Active sensing: LED emits, user reflects, PD receives echo.

waveform.notes: Optimization focuses on power and position, not specific waveform design.

channel_wireless.notes: Room 10×10×3m. LOS Lambertian channel. Blockage model with height threshold.

comm_metrics.notes: Aggregate sum rate up to ~480 Gbps (20 APs, 1W, 10 users). Min rate requirement 5-10 Gbps per user.

sensing_metrics.notes: Sensing MI as metric. Derived from ENR. Reflecting loss factor Γ=0.9. Active sensing via echo detection.

tradeoff.notes: Fig.5 shows trade-off: As comm priority Ωc increases 0→1, sum rate increases 30→175 Gbps while MI decreases 230→30 Gbps.
